kind: Array.prototype.every and some with live property iteration

scope: Intrinsic registration and early native dispatch
ToObject, captured LengthOfArrayLike, callable validation order
Live separate HasProperty/Get, holes, inherited indices, generic ordinary receivers
Exactly three callback arguments, actual-callee receiver handling, callback abrupt completion
Noncoercing ToBoolean, immediate decisive return, empty/exhausted defaults
Shared per-visit/per-edge work, callback allocation preflight, call/stack cleanup
Static inspection of three new Rust regression groups and expanded callback preflight group
record.conclusion: No concrete defect found in the bounded source review.
observations: Length retrieval and conversion precede callable validation even for an empty receiver. Both methods use the existing boxed-object and charged prototype/property path.

Every returns false for a falsy callback result and otherwise true after exhaustion; some reverses those outcomes. Value::truthy performs no author conversion and handles the implemented primitive/object kinds.
The decisive return occurs before another index key, HasProperty/Get, callback allocation, or species/result allocation. Neither method performs writes to the receiver.
Full safe-integer logical lengths stream through a u64 range, with per-visit charges and bounded sixteen-digit index storage; no allocation derives from logical length.
Native dispatch occurs before the later generic native argument-content scan, preserving ignored-extra-argument behavior.
Existing call machinery decrements call and shared stack state on success or error; the predicate branch introduces no persistent runtime state.

private_tests_static_review.name: generic_array_callback_preflight_keeps_completed_getter_effects
private_tests_static_review.observation: Expanded to forEach/every/some. Measures the unchanged length/Has/Get prefix, then supplies one byte less than the callback vector precharge. Checks getter effect retained, callback not run, terminal heap counter and empty call/frame/join state.

private_tests_static_review.name: frozen_array_predicate_cases_preserve_all_original_sources
private_tests_static_review.observation: Loads each CASE source unchanged and executes both modes with propertyHelper. Checks completion and call/stack/eval/frame cleanup. This test itself does not independently pin the fixture bytes; separate frozen matrix/provenance supplies that evidence.

private_tests_static_review.name: array_predicate_recursion_and_sparse_scans_share_terminal_limits
private_tests_static_review.observation: Both methods cover recursive length getter, length conversion, indexed getter, recursive callback, infinite callback and Infinity all-hole scan. Asserts uncatchable resource completion, skipped finally and cleaned call/stack/eval/frame state.

private_tests_static_review.name: array_predicate_early_return_does_not_allocate_from_logical_length
private_tests_static_review.observation: Compares exact allocation delta for lengths 1, 2^32-1 and 2^53-1 with an index-zero decisive callback; checks no result-array creation and clean call state. Meaningful allocation-independence control; it does not itself establish an exact final-step allowance boundary.

limits: Static review only: no Cargo builds, test execution, adapter execution or native runs were performed by this reviewer.
No source, fixture, policy or baseline was edited. Only this scratch review artifact was written.
Existing unsupported host receivers/prototype nodes remain explicitly refused; this review does not claim Proxy, typed-array, BigInt, cross-realm or full host-exotic support.
The existing per-edge conservative allocation charges and native/callback machinery were inspected as prerequisites; this was not a whole-runtime security audit.
Root owns execution of the new tests, complete upstream inventory and integrated validation.

record.review: Bounded independent Array every/some importer, runner and Python control review
scope: Importer/runner diff against HEAD before this increment
New Python controls and historical-contract test exclusions
Retained complete Git-tree proof validation and pinned source blob checks
New profile mode retention, metadata exclusions and preflight failure guards
record.conclusion: No concrete defect found in the bounded review. No change to production, tooling, corpus, policy, baseline or test expectation was needed.

observations: The importer adds only the two complete direct-file directories and selects the existing verified Git-tree path. Pinned repository, revision, root hash, proof parser, source blob validation and limits are unchanged.

Offline Git proof replay reconstructs canonical binary tree hashes for every entry and follows parent links from separately pinned root 91b2052adad1f066ae031e2ff3a1e9bd6d732886. It rejects incomplete/truncated, duplicate, unsafe, mis-hashed or extra proof data and compares selected test bytes to linked blob hashes.

All 32 prior profiles compare exactly between in-memory HEAD and candidate modules: directory/root definitions, source/harness bytes, source/mode/harness fingerprints, fixtures, supported feature sets, unsupported reasons, generated preflight identities and expected outcomes. This covers 13,437 cases and 2,612 preflights.

The new inventory contains 218 every and 219 some sources, with 437 sloppy and 430 strict variants. Seven noStrict sources explain the count difference; no selected source, mode or fixture is silently omitted.

The new feature policy is the same construction-plus-RegExp union used by adjacent profiles. Sixteen metadata exclusions remain in the denominator: twelve resizable-arraybuffer-only variants and four also requiring TypedArray. The other 851 variants reach normal execution classification; missing ordinary dependencies are not newly source-filtered.

All 96 new controls begin with method availability plus true and false single-element calls. Thus absent methods cannot satisfy later TypeError assertions. Twelve positive/wrong pairs per method run in both modes; paired setup is identical and only the final assertion differs.

Control neutral and terminal results are correct for both methods. Live mutation controls use captured length and inherited indices; short-circuit control has a throwing later getter; callback validation checks length getter and valueOf first. ToBoolean controls poison author conversion hooks.

No-species setup first creates a configurable ordinary constructor property before replacing it with a throwing getter. Metadata checks request restore:true, trigger unchanged propertyHelper inclusion, and separately reject construction.

The shared control validator still requires Test262Error for expected assertion failures and requires every positive and wrong partner to verify. Disabled assertions or blanket incidental errors cannot make the complete preflight healthy.
Historical tests exclude only the newly added profile from older historical digests. The new test independently covers all 32 immediately prior profiles, including array-descriptors.
Runner execution, case classification, old policy hashing and baseline regression checks are unchanged. Unsupported and resource observations remain distinct from passes and present in full reports.
python_control_review: Complete inventory and fixed source/mode/harness fingerprint
Proof truncation, omission and same-count replacement rejection
Offline import roundtrip requiring complete Git trees, never Contents API
Availability guards, paired assertion identity, strict-mode counts and helper restoration
All 32 prior contracts retained under a frozen digest
limits: No Cargo/build, engine/adapter execution, native run or corpus download was performed. Offline Python functions were exercised with adapter invocation replaced by capture-only callbacks.
The reported 195 passing Python tests came from the owner/root; this reviewer statically inspected the tests and ran the independent offline checks recorded here, not that full suite.
Git proof checks rely on the existing separately pinned official revision/root and standard Git SHA-1 object identity; no new cryptographic construction or network-origin claim is made.
This review does not establish engine semantic pass counts or full Array/ECMAScript compatibility. Root owns candidate runtime and complete corpus validation.

provenance.kind: Independent local every/some preparation; candidate not run

limits: The complete 437-source selection has 835 passed, 12 Date failures, four work-limit stops and 16 metadata-unsupported modes. All sources, modes, harness bytes, policy and preflight fingerprints remain fixed.

801 newly passing modes were failures. Four missing-method failures now expose missing Date, and four reach a million-index sparse scan that stops at the existing work quota. All 58 other complete case observations are unchanged.
Four older array-descriptor metadata cases now pass. All 13433 other older case observations and 2612 old controls are identical. No earlier pass is lost.

The 34 raw before passes were measured while the method was absent; the complete positive/negative preflight did not verify until implementation. New controls have 128 verified results after, 80 before. No fixture or preflight correction was necessary.
All 164 frozen local modes pass with identical fingerprints; all eight independent assertion controls retain their observations. The fixture is run in the Rust regression suite.
The new profile remains an observation inventory because resource stops persist. Existing healthy baselines remain 26; only the four gained descriptor cases update an older gate.

Full safe-integer logical lengths use bounded live scans. A decisive first callback allocates equally for lengths 1, u32 maximum and maximum safe integer. Generic host receivers, Proxy, typed arrays and cross-realm behavior remain incomplete.

No work, heap, recursion quota or process authority was increased. Bounded independent source/tooling reviews are not a security audit. No GPU exercise or Chromium performance comparison was performed.
